title: Authoritative MariaDB Settings Hydration in ModulesSettings.jsx, Admin Settings & Coupon System in Plans.jsx
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
backend/routes/platform.js:252 authoritatively returns _settingsSource: 'mariadb'.
However, ModulesSettings.jsx:62, Plans.jsx:122, websiteSettings.jsx:45, socialSettings.jsx:35 check settings?._settingsSource === 'remote'.
Consequently, isAuthoritative is permanently false, blocking admins from saving module toggles and disabling checkout coupons.

### 2. ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. Export unified helper isAuthoritativeSettings(settings) in src/utils/moduleFlags.js that accepts 'mariadb' and 'remote' and rejects stale configs.
2. Update ModulesSettings.jsx, Plans.jsx, websiteSettings.jsx, socialSettings.jsx, and anlyticsSettings.jsx to use this helper.
3. Ensure persistModules saves cleanly to /api/admin/modules without error toast.
4. Ensure Plans.jsx coupon form renders when enabled.

### 3. IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
- S1: Author isAuthoritativeSettings in src/utils/moduleFlags.js.
- S2: Wire helper into ModulesSettings.jsx.
- S3: Wire helper into Plans.jsx.
- S4: Wire helper into remaining admin settings panels.
- S5: Author test suite tests/dir057-settings-hydration.test.mjs.
